en: Black-and-white multi-view postcard with four photographs of a modern socialist-era town: a tram running between prefabricated apartment blocks with a town coat of arms, a low modern shopping center with parked cars, a formal building with a small monument bust in front, and a large housing estate with many parked cars. In the center is the town name "COSWIG" in bold letters. Visible signage includes German words such as "Poliklinik" on a medical facility and "Kaufhalle" on the department store.
